title: Marc Stad takes controlling stake in Timberwolves and Lynx in $4.5bn deal
dek: Marc Stad acquired controlling ownership of the Minnesota Timberwolves and Minnesota Lynx in a transaction valuing both franchises at $4.5 billion, making it the fourth-largest NBA franchise sale in history. Co-chairman Alex Rodriguez is increasing his investment and expanding his governance roles pending league approval.
author: The GoCheckMySports Desk
key_fact: Marc Stad became controlling owner of the Minnesota Timberwolves and Lynx in a deal valuing the combined franchises at $4.5 billion, the fourth-largest NBA franchise sale on record.
bottom_line: The ownership restructuring is now subject to NBA league approval for Rodriguez's expanded governance roles. The completed transition signals continued capital investment and leadership focus on both the NBA and WNBA franchises moving forward.
body:
Marc Stad transitioned from minority investor to controlling owner of the Minnesota Timberwolves and Minnesota Lynx in a transaction valued at $4.5 billion combined, according to BBC Sport reporting. The deal ranks as the fourth-largest franchise sale in NBA history.
Stad acquired the majority stake held by co-chairman Marc Lore, who along with Alex Rodriguez initially invested in the Minnesota franchises in 2021 at a $1.5 billion valuation with an agreement to purchase the team in full. Lore and Rodriguez assumed full control of the basketball teams last year.
Rodriguez confirmed the news Friday on social media, writing, 'One of the great joys I've had in my career is spending the last few years helping build the Timberwolves and Lynx with my friend and partner Marc Lore. I'm very excited to announce that this incredible journey reaches a new level today.' Rodriguez will increase his investment and assume expanded governance roles, pending league approval. He will serve as co-chairman, Governor of the Lynx, and alternate Governor of the Timberwolves, with plans to spend more time with the franchises.
Stad will join Rodriguez and Lore as co-chairman. Per BBC Sport, Marc and Elisa Stad will be increasing their investment alongside Rodriguez's expanded commitment.
The roster includes four-time NBA All-Star Anthony Edwards, per BBC Sport reporting.
This ownership transition marks the second major NBA franchise sale this month, following a record-breaking transaction involving the LA Lakers last week.
